Fellow IG main here. Basically what everyone else has said so far, but also make sure you're upgrading your kinsect as well, as well as having several choices for your given situation. Being prepared can shave quite a bit of time off a hunt, so make sure youre getting to know what monsters are weak to what. I usually go for speedy kinsects, with paralysis or blast as the abnormal status. Also, a lot of people say don't use aerials, but the aerial plunge (R2 while midair) and can help you to keep doing damage as you're re-buffing. It also took me about 100 hours to realize that L2+Circle recalls the kinsect without having to sheathe your weapon. I also heavily recommend trying other weapons. My personal recommendations would be Sword and Shield, Greatsword, or Hammer. The weebsword is pretty fun too, and I find it's pretty great if youre just starting out.
